stage: development pilot followed by held-out confirmation only if development gate passes
trace: six bulk long-input requests at 2ms intervals, six short-input interactive requests starting at 30ms at 2ms intervals; all arrival offsets relative to exogenous origin
quality_gate: identical greedy token IDs for every corresponding request across all compared configurations; report failures rather than exclude them
performance_gate: at least 20% interactive P95 reduction against strongest compatible native slot setting; throughput at least 95% of throughput of that baseline, no extra errors, same per-worker hard memory cap
independent_baseline_gate: simple_cost2 uses the same size-proxy admission heuristic outside Lattice; matching it alone is not an algorithmic novelty claim
limits: Synthetic stress trace, not production workload prevalence
P95 samples per trace are small; confirmation must report trace/session-clustered intervals
Finite native slot sweep is not proof of globally optimal native tuning
No task complexity understanding claim from bytes/token cap proxy
